verdict: ROAS surged this period; purchase pace is real but uneven day-to-day.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $3.54 for every $1.00 spent — a sharp improvement driven largely by the Muslim Subscription Box campaign, which accounted for just over half of total spend. The wins are real, but purchases have arrived in bursts rather than a steady daily flow, so the strong 28-day number reflects a handful of high-volume days rather than consistent momentum. To keep the pipeline moving, we're pressing forward on the content refresh; a live-cooking shoot that was scheduled for August 14th is being rescheduled to restore the creative supply. Three milestones land on August 31st — funnel testing, SEO guardrails, and a platform decision — and completing those will give the ads more structure to run against heading into September.
